toast_relationship_legend.toast_native: Toast already computes this — pull via Toast Analytics API (import)

toast_relationship_legend.wineops_bridge: Fuses Toast POS data with WineOps wine intelligence (unique value)
toast_relationship_legend.wineops_only: Not in Toast at all — WineOps-native
toast_relationship_legend.integration: Plumbing to bring Toast data into WineOps

build_strategy_legend.import: Ingest from Toast Analytics API; render (optionally wine-filtered)
build_strategy_legend.bridge: Join Toast POS data with WineOps wine/vendor data
build_strategy_legend.embed: Prefer linking to Toast's own report
